BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Boards/Commission/Committee meetings, listed below, that they have attended or that have occurred.
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF SEPTEMBER 12, SEPTEMBER 20, AND SEPTEMBER 26, 2023
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meetings of September 12, September 20, and September 26, 2023.
A-1 Minutes 9-12-23 CC SA
A-1 Minutes 9-20-23 CC SA
A-1 Minutes 9-26-23 CC SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT RESOLUTION NO. 23-5833
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 23-5833 approving Warrant Register No. 1561.
D-1 Warrant Resolution #1561
D-2
PRESENTATION OF SEPTEMBER 2023 INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-2 September Investment Report Staff Report
D-2 September Investment Report Attachments A-D Reports
D-3
PRESENTATION OF SEPTEMBER 2023 REQUISITION SUMMARY REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-3 September Requisition Summary Report Staff Report
D-3 September Requestion Summary Report Attachment A Report
D-4
SECOND READING OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING TITLE 8 (BUILDING REGULATIONS) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE ADDING CHAPTER 8.50 SETTING FORTH PROCEDURES FOR AN EXPEDITED PERMIT PROCESS FOR ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING SYSTEMS AND ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION FOR AN APPLICATION CHECKLIST FOR THE EXPEDITED PERMIT PROCESS FOR ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING SYSTEMS
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Ordinance No. 23-983, an ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente amending Title 8 (Building Regulations) of the La Puente Municipal Code adding Chapter 8.50 setting forth procedures for an expedited permit process for Electric Vehicle Charging Systems; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 23-5829 for an application checklist for the expedited permit process for electric vehicle charging systems.
D-4 EV Charging Ordinance 2nd Reading Staff Report
D-4 EV Charging Ordinance 2nd Reading Attachment A Ordinance
D-4 EV Charging Ordinance 2nd Reading Attachment B Resolution
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 23-5813 AND AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE PERSONNEL SYSTEM FOR FULL-TIME POSITIONS TO ADD A FULL-TIME CHIEF/DIRECTOR OF PUBLIC SAFETY
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Resolution No. 23-5834 rescinding resolution No. 23-5813 amending the comprehensive personnel system; (2) approve the job description for the full-time Chief/ Director of Public Safety position; and (3) provide any necessary direction to Staff.
D-5 Full-Time Chief-Director of Public Safety Staff Report
D-5 Full-Time Chief-Director of Public Safety Attachment A Resolution
D-5 Full-Time Chief-Director of Public Safety Attachment B Job Description
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
PRESENTATION OF SEPTEMBER 2023 BUDGET REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
E-1 September Budget Report Staff Report
E-1 September Budget Report Attachment A Report
E-2
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING A CONCEPTUAL DESIGN FOR A DOG PARK/ANIMAL SHELTER AND CONSIDERATION OF CONTRACT WITH TAP QUALIFIED ARCHITECURAL CONTRACTOR UTILIZING MEASURE A FUNDING IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $90,000
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) discuss this item and provide direction to Staff of the proposed location for the City Dog Park and Animal Shelter; and (2) authorize the City Manager to select an Architect from TAP's list of qualified consultants and enter into a contract for up to $90,000.00 to produce formal design options for the Dog Park and Animal Shelter.
E-2 Dog Park Animal Shelter Staff Report
E-2 Dog Park Animal Shelter Attachment A TAP Qualified Consultants
E-2 Dog Park Animal Shelter Attachment B Conceptual Draft

ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
